tasks.title: Audit concept coverage for this building
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: List supported component types and missing concepts without presuming their presence
Distinguish known vocabulary from building-specific evidence

tasks.title: Research missing architectural concept types
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Add sourced definitions, aliases, purposes, positions, materials and recognition cues where needed
Avoid creating building-specific types when the term is more general

tasks.title: Formalize component hierarchy and relation vocabulary
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Define part-of, supports, adjacent-to, decorated-with and accessed-through as appropriate
Document typed, directed, evidence-specific links rather than generic adjacency guesses

tasks.title: Instantiate physical architectural elements
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Assign stable specimen-specific IDs to evidenced parts and repeated instances
Map every identified instance to a canonical architectural component type

tasks.title: Map structural and spatial part relationships
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Create component-to-component and component-to-space links with typed predicates
Validate referenced IDs and mark interpretive relationships explicitly

tasks.title: Attach spatial transforms and structural positions
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Store coordinates, units, orientation and level for each positioned instance
Trace transforms to measurements or label estimates and uncertainty

tasks.title: Annotate materials and fabrication roles
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Describe supported material families, finishes and construction roles per instance
Clearly distinguish demonstrated ancient conditions from modern replacements

tasks.title: Connect instances to historical phases
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Record which building phases each instance belongs to
Identify restored, missing and conjectural instances where documented

tasks.title: Record evidence and confidence per instance
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace significant attributes and instance claims to specific source identifiers
Mark uncertain, conflicting and unknown elements rather than inserting defaults

tasks.title: Define stable mesh-to-ontology mapping contract
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Assign unique public mesh/instance IDs and canonical type references
Define picking and grouping rules for repeated geometry and unmodeled elements

tasks.title: Write visitor-facing component interpretations
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Explain terminology, architectural function and recognized visible features
Provide cited, concise alternative text without asserting unsupported fidelity

tasks.title: Check cross-building concept reusability
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep general vocabulary independent of this one building
Preserve stable IDs and document compatibility impacts of any new relations

tasks.title: Validate ontology coverage and source traceability
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Check every documented modeled instance has a valid type and traceable evidence
Report unmapped components, missing relations and uncertain spatial values

tasks.title: Verify machine-readable ontology contract
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate machine-readable records, references, uniqueness and typed relation consistency
Document schema version and round-trip integrity checks

tasks.title: Test actual interactive instance selection and navigation
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify picking maps the selected geometry to its precise instance and type
Test relationship navigation, repeat instances and accessible text alternatives

tasks.title: Approve specimen ontology release
tasks.description: Deliver and verify this stage of the ontology workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm hierarchy, spatial data, provenance, semantic picking and public explanations
Document verified coverage and explicitly unresolved ontology gaps
